zin_dark_is_dark = {
	has_country_flag = zin_region_dark_lands
}

zin_dark_is_hold = {
	zin_dark_is_dark = yes
	NOT = { original_tag = Y1A }
	NOT = { original_tag = Y19 }
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = zin_people_orcs
		has_country_flag = zin_people_trolls
		has_country_flag = zin_people_minor_goblins
	}
}

zin_dark_is_free_hold = {
	zin_dark_is_hold = yes
	is_subject = no
}

zin_dark_is_tributary = {
	is_subject_of = Y1A
	has_autonomy_state = zin_autonomy_tributary_hold
}

zin_dark_is_accord_member = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			original_tag = Y19
			is_in_faction = yes

		is_in_faction_with = Y19
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_war_open = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
		has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
		Y1A = { has_war = yes }
		AND = {
			zin_dark_date_defiance_cb = yes
			OR = {
				any_country = {
					zin_dark_is_dark = yes
					Y1A = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_hold_defiance scope = PREV } }
				}
				any_country = {
					zin_dark_is_dark = yes
					Y1A = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_orc_raids scope = PREV } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_holds_strait_shore = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_strait = 1 }
			any_state = { zin_is_site_dark_strait_north_shore = yes }
			NOT = {
				any_state = {
					zin_is_site_dark_strait_north_shore = yes
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							is_controlled_by = PREV
							controller = { is_subject_of = PREV.PREV }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_strait = 2 }
			any_state = { zin_is_site_dark_strait_south_shore = yes }
			NOT = {
				any_state = {
					zin_is_site_dark_strait_south_shore = yes
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							is_controlled_by = PREV
							controller = { is_subject_of = PREV.PREV }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_shore_barred = {
	any_state = { zin_is_site_dark_strait_north_shore = yes }
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			zin_is_site_dark_strait_north_shore = yes
